# Architecture Overview

*Generated by /shipwithai-starter on 2026-07-01. Edit directly.*

## System overview

feature_flag is a self-hosted Feature Flag management API (similar to Flagsmith), built with Java 21 + Spring Boot 4.1.0.
Architecture style: modular monolith.

Supports multi-tenant flag management via an Org → Project → Environment hierarchy, exposing a JWT-secured Admin API and an API-key-secured SDK evaluation API.

## Key layers

| Layer | Directory | Responsibility |
|-------|-----------|----------------|
| Controller | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/controller/` | HTTP handlers, split into `admin/`, `auth/`, `sdk/` |
| Service | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/service/` | Business logic (interfaces + `impl/`) |
| Repository | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/repository/` | Spring Data JPA repositories |
| Domain | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/domain/` | JPA entities (`entity/`) and enums (`enums/`) |
| Security | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/security/` | Two `SecurityFilterChain` beans: JWT admin auth + API-key SDK auth |
| DTO | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/dto/` | `request/` and `response/` payloads |
| Config | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/config/` | Spring configuration (security chains, OpenAPI, etc.) |
| Exception | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/exception/` | Exception handling |
| Util | `src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/util/` | Shared utilities (e.g. `ApiKeyGenerator`) |

## Entry points

- `controller/admin/**` → JWT-secured Admin API (Org/Project/Environment/FeatureFlag CRUD)
- `controller/auth/**` → Authentication endpoints (login, JWT issuance)
- `controller/sdk/**` → API-key-secured SDK evaluation API (`EvaluationController`)

## Data model hierarchy

```
Organization → Project → Environment (has API key)
                       → FeatureFlag (has immutable key slug)
                             ↕
                    FlagEnvironmentState (enabled + value per env)
```

`FlagEnvironmentState` is auto-created for every existing environment when a new `FeatureFlag` is created — a flag always has exactly one state row per environment.

## External dependencies

| Service | Purpose | Connection |
|---------|---------|------------|
| PostgreSQL | Primary datastore, schema owned by Liquibase | `spring.datasource.url` (see `application.properties`) |

## Key directories

```
src/main/java/org/aibles/feature_flag/
  config/           Spring configuration (SecurityConfig defines 2 filter chains)
  controller/
    admin/          JWT-secured Admin API
    auth/           Login / token issuance
    sdk/            API-key-secured SDK evaluation API
  domain/
    entity/         JPA entities
    enums/          Domain enums
  dto/
    request/        Request payloads
    response/       Response payloads
  exception/        Exception handling
  repository/       Spring Data JPA repositories
  security/         ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter, JwtAuthenticationFilter, principals
  service/
    impl/           Service implementations
  util/             ApiKeyGenerator, etc.

src/main/resources/
  application.properties
  db/changelog/
    db.changelog-master.xml
    migrations/     001–007, Liquibase-owned schema (append-only)
```

## What to know before touching code

- `FeatureFlag.key` is immutable — set at creation, never updated (`FeatureFlagServiceImpl.update()` intentionally ignores it).
- Security filter chain order matters: SDK chain (`/api/v1/sdk/**`, order=1) before Admin chain (order=2).
- `PermissionService` (not controllers) enforces `OrganizationMember.role` checks before mutations.
- DB schema is Liquibase-owned (`ddl-auto=validate`) — never modify an already-run changeset, always add a new one under `db/changelog/migrations/`.
- `ApiKeyGenerator` uses `SecureRandom` → 32 bytes → 64-char hex string; runs on environment creation and key rotation.

See `CLAUDE.md` for full development conventions and workflow gates.
